changes.title: AWS IAM announces Access Troubleshooter to debug access denied errors
changes.detail: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) introduces Access Troubleshooter , a new capability that gives you visibility into the full authorization context behind access denied errors so you can resolve them without trial-and-error. Previously, developers relied on the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the denying policy to debug a denial, with no visibility into the authorization context or other policies evaluated in the request that could contribute to the denial.
